svg.text: EduTaskDB (Microsoft SQL Server) · Chen notation · 4 strong · 6 weak · 4 associative entities · 23 relationships (13 identifying)
Strong entity — a table that stands on its own
Weak entity — cannot exist without its owner (double box)
Associative entity — resolves a many-to-many link
Attribute — column name, with its SQL data type beneath
Relationship — how two entities are linked
Identifying relationship — owner supplies the identity (double diamond)
Underlined = primary key · Italic = foreign key
Dashed — logical link, not enforced by an FK constraint
Cardinality: 1 : N reads “one … to many …” · 1 : 1 reads “exactly one”. Types read from sys.columns on EduTaskDB.
